messages:
Anya (PM): quick sync — trying to settle sequencing for next 2 quarters. proposal: prioritize Dedicated (capacity/throughput) first, then ship a narrow Private v1 focused on control and certs. want quick RICE pass and launch guardrails.

Mike L. (Eng): +1 to landing Dedicated first. we can use existing runtime optimizations and autoscale work to hit throughput targets. question: what "minimal" Private features are non-negotiable?

Sophia (Sales): from field: two enterprise customers (Acme Health, OptiSaaS) asked for isolation + audit logs asap. Acme will pay for Dedicated commit but wants VPC+audit too. OptiSaaS says Private-only unless we offer strict tenancy guarantees. so both are high-reach.

Jordan R. (Infra): technically Private v1 that supports VPC and KMS is heavier. could cut to: Private v1 = control plane in customer VPC (no on-prem), KMS support, basic audit events. full air-gapped/on-prem later. that cuts scope by ~60% vs full Private.

Taylor (Product Ops): RICE quick draft:
```
Feature        Reach    Impact    Confidence    Effort    Score
Dedicated v1     200k     3         70%           8         52
Private-narrow   50k      4         60%           13        18
```
Notes: rough units; effort in person-weeks.

Anya (PM): thanks. math looks reasonable. tradeoffs: Dedicated unlocks mid-market revenue quickly and improves platform SLOs for everyone. Private-narrow addresses legal/compliance asks but costs more to build and maintain.

Mike L. (Eng): build notes: Dedicated v1 deliverables = autoscaler, predictable slot sizing, SLA telemetry, quota controls. could do canary rollout to 1 customer group in Q1. Private-narrow deliverables = customer control plane + KMS + audit log stream. we should decide if audit retention is our responsibility or customer's.

Sophia (Sales): audit retention = key ask. Acme requires 12 months retention by default. if we offload retention to customers (S3), they'd need infra ops. better to offer 12mo managed for premium tier.

Jordan R. (Infra): ops cost estimate: Private-managed retention + encryption => ~2x operational load initially. If we scope Private v1 to "managed metadata + pointer to customer storage" we can reduce ops. e.g., keep indexes/log pointers internally, store raw blobs in customer S3.

Anya (PM): propose decision: 1) commit to Dedicated-first roadmap (Q1) with canary and SLA obs 2) ship Private-narrow in Q2 but with scoping: KMS, VPC peering, audit pointers + optional managed retention as paid add-on. 3) gate Private GA on 3 pilot customers and stability metrics: <1% error rate, <2x ops incidents vs baseline, and documented runbook. thoughts?

Mike L. (Eng): that gating sounds fair. need agreement on "pilot customers" criteria and support window. also flag: dependency on KMS integration work for Private — we should prioritize an internal spike.

Sophia (Sales): I'll loop Acme + OptiSaaS for pilot interest. they both are likely. note: OptiSaaS needs a firm timeline.

Taylor (Product Ops): I'll add the gating metrics to the launch checklist and create an internal RICE doc with updated numbers and owner tags.

ops-bot: reminder — please update the roadmap board card when you finalize decision: /remind me to update roadmap in 2d :calendar: 

Anya (PM): ok action items: @Mike L. spike KMS + estimate (due +10d), @Jordan draft ops cost delta (due +7d), @Taylor update RICE + checklist (due +3d), @Sophia confirm pilot commitments (due +5d). we'll reconvene after those artifacts. :thumbsup:
